literal_meaning: যমের দ্বারা ধরা পড়া (caught by Yama)
example_sentences_in_bangla: বুড়ো মানুষটি শেষ পর্যন্ত যমে ধরা হলো।
example_sentences_in_english: He was caught by Yama in the accident.
The old man was finally caught by Yama.
history: This idiom references Yama, the Hindu god of death from ancient Indian mythology, symbolizing the inevitability of death in Bengali folklore.
note: Yama is a central figure in Hindu texts like the Rigveda, influencing Bengali expressions of mortality.
